ballPolicy: This fall/get-up action has no carried-ball track; game ball remains independent and simulation-owned. Leo keeps empty hands and no ball is drawn.

review.reviewNotes: Ten distinct complete poses show safe loss of balance, supported fall, roll to a knee, push-up and composed return to stance. Leo remains pale, adult and human with long wavy black hair, refined mustache and black/crimson kit; anatomy remains plausible with no injury cues.
